policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen - "sees 3 of 14" - is derived from the account roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (account, channel, family, plant, supplier).

policies.name: Customer view
policies.desc: A document for a customer carries its own cost lines and the agreement's clauses; other customers' prices, supplier terms and margin by family stay restricted.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader's permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: Open months
policies.desc: A month with close_status Open is never read as actuals; every margin figure names the certified close it reads.
